_about: The promotional images that carry Grug Digital's embedded photo metadata (IPTC/XMP), written by src/seo/tag_images.py: game screenshots, character renders, building renders and the logo. Textures, reference sheets, placeholders, sponsor and third-party images are deliberately left out. Each entry: title, description, keywords (the shared defaults are in tag_images.py).
